name: Mwijay Note - Weekly PDF Report (PDF.co)

parameters.subject: 📊 Your Mwijay Note Weekly Report is Ready
parameters.message:
Weekly Report Ready 📊

Hi {{ $('Build Report HTML').item.json.userName }}, your Mwijay Note weekly summary has been generated.

Download Your PDF Report →

Link expires in 24 hours. Generated by Mwijay Note Automation.

notes:
SETUP CHECKLIST:
1. Replace YOUR_PDF_CO_API_KEY_HERE with your API key from https://pdf.co
2. Configure your SMTP credentials in the 'Email PDF Link to User' node (same as welcome_email_workflow)
3. The manual webhook URL: https://YOUR_N8N_DOMAIN/webhook/mwijay-pdf-request
4. The scheduler runs automatically every Friday at 8 PM (server time). Make sure your EC2 timezone is set correctly.
5. For the scheduled run, you will need to feed user data from Firebase. Connect a Firebase Firestore node before 'Build Report HTML' to pull weekly data.
